scientific_integrity: The all-a result follows from an explicit proof of a Fibonacci-word concatenation and a gap-run multiset recurrence. Finite exact arithmetic tests are supporting checks only. The length-one case and the underlying Apéry theorem are attributed to prior work, not claimed as new. No independent mathematical verification has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Only the numerical semigroups generated by Fibonacci shifts for integer a >= 5 are classified; locations of all gap blocks and other generator families are not determined. Uses the independently published Zeckendorf Apéry formula as a premise; an unindexed prior full-spectrum result remains a priority risk.
title: The complete Fibonacci run-length spectrum of shifted-Fibonacci numerical semigroup gaps
